text:
Elliot Price: Heads up — need to lock the docs publication checklist for marketplace go-live. Trying to avoid the usual “listing links 404 for 3 hrs” situation 🙃

Elliot Price: Current docs PRs in flight:
- AWS marketplace page: redwood-docs PR #4821
- GCP marketplace page: redwood-docs PR #4829
- Pricing/packaging refs: redwood-docs PR #4835

Elliot Price: Checklist I’m tracking (please add anything missing):
1) Merge PRs + confirm deploy to prod
2) Add redirects from old `/marketplace/*` paths
3) Update left nav + top-level “Getting started” links
4) Validate external links (AWS listing, GCP listing, security packet request form, support contact)
5) Search index + sitemap updates
6) Docs publish time coordinated w/ Partnerships flipping listings live

Kira Thompson: +1. Also need to confirm the “Buying via marketplace” FAQ link exists and is in nav. Sales keeps sending prospects to a draft google doc.

Soojin Lee: Yep. For listings we are pointing to:
- `https://docs.redwoodinference.com/docs/marketplace/aws`
- `https://docs.redwoodinference.com/docs/marketplace/gcp`
- FAQ anchor under both pages

Soojin Lee: Please do NOT change those slugs if possible — we already submitted them in AWS draft fields.

Elliot Price: Got it. We can keep slugs stable. Right now in PR #4821/#4829 the paths are `/docs/marketplace/aws` and `/docs/marketplace/gcp`.

Elliot Price: We have older content from last year at `/docs/guides/marketplace` (thin page) — I’ll set redirects:
- `/docs/guides/marketplace` -> `/docs/marketplace/aws` (and add a callout for GCP)
- `/marketplace` -> `/docs/marketplace/aws` (historical inbound)

Connor O'Brien: From release side, marketplace listing go-live target is Wed 10am PT. Can we have docs live by Tues EOD so we can do a full QA pass + crawl check?

Elliot Price: Yes. Targeting merge by Tues 2pm PT.

Elliot Price: Nav updates: today “Cloud” section doesn’t have Marketplace. Proposing:
- Add “Cloud Marketplace” section with AWS + GCP child pages
- Add a single link from Pricing page “Buying through AWS/GCP Marketplace” -> AWS page (with tabs / prominent switch to GCP)

Kira Thompson: Please don’t bury GCP. Maybe add both links on Pricing page or a “Choose your marketplace” card.

Soojin Lee: Agree. Buyer intent is different; GCP reviewers also prefer their own steps to be front-and-center.

Elliot Price: Cool, we’ll add two buttons on Pricing page.

DocsBot: build started for commit `9a4c1d7` (redwood-docs) on `preview/marketplace-pages`

Rafael Mendes: Quick ask: can you add a note on both pages about what to do if entitlements don’t show up within X minutes? Support is expecting “it didn’t activate” tickets.

Dev Patel: +1. We want a consistent line: “Activation usually completes in ~5 minutes; if it’s been >30 minutes, contact support with your AWS/GCP account ID + Redwood org slug.”

Elliot Price: Makes sense. I’ll add a Troubleshooting section with:
- entitlement delay
- linked to wrong org
- region mismatch
and a “What to include in your ticket” list.

Elliot Price: @Rafael Mendes what’s the safe SLA language? Don’t want to promise 5 min if we can’t back it.

Rafael Mendes: Use: “typically within a few minutes” and “if it takes longer than 30 minutes” as the escalation threshold. That’s aligned with SRE alerting.

Elliot Price: Perfect.

Camila Reyes: Also pls confirm the docs pages include the official support email (not individual names) and no mention of “SOC2 available publicly” (it’s NDA only).

Soojin Lee: +1. Security language should match Naomi/Aisha sign-off. There was a specific sentence they wanted: “SOC 2 report available under NDA upon request.”

Elliot Price: Noted. I’ll do a final sweep for security claims.

Kira Thompson: Redirects: can we also handle `/aws-marketplace` and `/gcp-marketplace`? I’ve seen those in Zendesk macros.

Dev Patel: Yep we’ve been sharing those short links informally.

Elliot Price: Sure — will add:
- `/aws-marketplace` -> `/docs/marketplace/aws`
- `/gcp-marketplace` -> `/docs/marketplace/gcp`

Connor O'Brien: For QA: can someone run a quick broken link check after merge? We’ve had trailing slash issues.

Elliot Price: I can run `npm run lint:links` plus a manual click-through. If needed I’ll ask release eng to run the crawler.

DocsBot: preview deployment ready: https://redwood-docs-preview.example.com/docs/marketplace/aws

Elliot Price: Preview is up. Everyone please eyeball:
- header/footer links
- “Contact support” points to correct page
- AWS page mentions “Subscribe in AWS Marketplace” step w/ correct capitalization

Soojin Lee: Looking now. One nit: on AWS page, step 2 says “Create a Redwood account” — procurement buyers may already have an org. Can we say “Sign in or create an org”?

Elliot Price: Yep, updating copy to “Sign in to the Redwood Console (or create an org)”.

Kira Thompson: GCP page: the “Enable APIs” step links to Google docs. Is that allowed? Should we keep all steps on our page?

Elliot Price: GCP reviewers sometimes like referencing their official doc. But we can keep it as “optional reference” and keep primary steps on our page.

Rafael Mendes: Add a small callout for “If you use private networking / VPC, see Redwood Private docs” — lots of enterprise folks ask.

Elliot Price: I’ll add a link to Private deployment overview (existing page) and clarify that marketplace purchase ≠ automatic private install.

Camila Reyes: Nav: please avoid introducing a new top-level nav item that shifts other items around too much. Minor change only so people don’t think docs “moved.”

Elliot Price: Understood — we’ll add a single “Cloud Marketplace” group under the existing “Guides” section, no global rearrange.

Connor O'Brien: Timing confirmation:
- Docs merged + published: Tues by 2pm PT
- Internal QA: Tues 2–5pm
- Listings go-live: Wed 10am PT

Connor O'Brien: If we slip, we need a rollback plan (at minimum, listing links should still resolve).

Elliot Price: Rollback plan: even if new pages aren’t live, we’ll keep redirects pointing to existing stable page (worst case the thin `/docs/guides/marketplace` page) so listing links don’t 404. But goal is no rollback.

Dev Patel: Can you add a “Known issues” line re: multiple AWS accounts? That’s the #1 confusion: purchase on one account, login on another.

Elliot Price: Adding a bullet: “Make sure you sign in with the same AWS/GCP account that completed the purchase, or provide the purchaser account ID to support.”

Soojin Lee: :thumbsup: Also please add UTM-safe links (no hardcoded UTMs in docs). Ben asked to keep attribution on listing side, not docs.

Elliot Price: Yep, no UTMs.

DocsBot: build succeeded on preview for commit `c11f0a2`

Elliot Price: Action items:
- Elliot: add redirects (`/marketplace`, `/docs/guides/marketplace`, `/aws-marketplace`, `/gcp-marketplace`), nav updates, troubleshooting copy, security wording sweep
- Kira: review GCP steps + confirm no confusing external dependencies
- Soojin/Camila: final copy review (headline + security sentence)
- Connor: slot QA window + confirm with Partnerships that listing URLs are final

Elliot Price: Please drop comments by EOD so I can merge tomorrow.

Kira Thompson: Will do. I’ll review preview tonight and leave inline comments on #4829.

Soojin Lee: Reviewing now. If all good, I’ll give :white_check_mark: in PR and in this thread.

Connor O'Brien: Thanks all — keeping this thread as the source of truth for the docs go-live checklist.
